rule:
rg19: lag-aware message-reconciler grace (RG) vs main. Bead br-9ott5 (and br-kp1in.13). Written 2026-10-21 ~00:20Z, before the
RG build finished and before any rg19 run. The file's birth time is its timestamp.

DISCLOSED CONTEXT. Everything below was seen before this rule.
- ab18 runs 1 and 2 (main 2b5d14d7 + br-tsqvm fix; base vs SP+L2+L3), P2:
  - file_reservation_paths errors: base 2,417/2,633 (91.8%); cand 787/2,633;
  - every contended fence wait of 2 s or more was held by recovery/message_reconcile/database.rs:598: base 6, cand 61;
  - reconciler per run: ~5k scans, 0 repaired, 418-1,036 unchanged, 3.7-4.6k deferred;
  - completion: base 619.6 s, cand 634.5 s.
- Any ab18 runs that finish before rg19 starts will also have been seen. They measure a different candidate, and none of their
  numbers set a threshold below.

THE LEVER (rgrace_v1.patch b5b43bf5, worktree rc1020g = 2b5d14d7 + tsqvm_v1.patch + RG, crates diff b0af7e9bc610):
- reconcile_message_batch_inner computes its cutoff as now - (30 s + min(archive_lag_snapshot().oldest_unmaterialized_us, 10 min)),
  and still applies max(settled_before_us), so rows from before the process started skip the grace.
- Failed WBQ writes still reach the reconciler through durability::seed_retries.
- Unit test in_flight_cutoff_extends_the_grace_by_the_archive_lag. Its negative case: a fixed-grace cutoff fails the 120 s
  assertion.

ARMS (portable release, same host, host lock):
- base = build36/ab18b_base/am, sha256 3d35263d06e664f345572b9175c7102d445ba6e87b0ccf11a1ca491f5401e254. This is the same binary
  as ab18's base. It is re-run live in rg19; no ab18 number is reused.
- cand = build36/rgrace_cand2/am, sha256 recorded at freeze. (Note 2026-10-21 03:35Z, no data involved: the first build,
  rgrace_cand, lost its worker after 3 h, with completion unconfirmed on vmi1227854. It was rebuilt from the same tree as
  rgrace_cand2, excluding that worker.) The build log must show diff=b0af7e9bc610, and the binary must
  differ from base.

RUNS: as ab18 (load gate < 8, foreign-CPU validity, re-queue up to 6 h).
- P2: base cand cand base base cand.
- P6: cand base base cand.
- Release smoke in both orders (cand_vs_base, base_vs_cand).
- The same server env as ab18.

PRIMARY. Both must hold.
- R1: over pooled valid P2 runs, the cand file_reservation_paths error rate is at most 25% of base's.
- R2: across all valid cand P2 and P6 server logs, there are 0 "archive publication fence contended" waits of 2 s or more whose
  holder site is recovery/message_reconcile/database.rs.

GUARDS (any failure = LOSS):
- G1 throughput: P2 completion median cand <= 1.05x base; smoke swarm acked sends cand >= 0.95x base in each order.
- G2 failures:
  - non-reservation paced tool errors cand <= base + 5 (pooled P2, and pooled P6);
  - smoke tool errors (swarm + soak) cand <= base + 5 in each order;
  - cand crash phase PASS in each order;
  - integrity_check ok;
  - no "canonical message id ... already exists" error in any cand server log.
- G3: P6 send p99 and last-60 s send p90 cand <= 1.2x base; every P6 completion <= 330 s.
- G4 convergence, because the reconciler exists to repair:
  - post-swarm un-archived cand <= base + 2% of cand's acked swarm sends, in each order;
  - the smoke soak check "archive converges after load stops" must not pass for base and fail for cand in either order.
- C:
  - storage message_reconcile tests and storage clippy -D warnings on rc1020g (lane vrg1);
  - if R1, R2 and G1-G4 hold: storage lib nextest (only br-3ukrb's test may fail, and only identically on base), tools it and
    conformance on the landing tree.

REPORTED, not gated:
- the bead probe: cand reservation error rate <= 1% and R2;
- reconciler scans, unchanged, deferred and repaired per run;
- fence-contended waits by holder site;
- WBQ depth and lag at end of run;
- reservation p50/p99;
- send p50/p90, with the closed-loop caveat.

DECISION:
- WIN only if R1, R2, G1-G4 and C hold.
- The reconciler is recovery code owned by its maintainer. A WIN is posted on br-9ott5 with the evidence for the owner to land.
  It is not landed unilaterally.
- br-9ott5 closes only when its own probe passes on a landed build.
- LOSS: one line on br-9ott5; nothing lands.

  - P2 grant refusals: base 928.7, cand 295.5 per 1,000. P6: base 766.4, cand 2.3.
  - P2 completion: cand 1.12x base.

  - In every ab18 server log the 2 s+ fence waits were held by the message reconciler.
  None of it changes a threshold here.
- Timestamp correction (appended later): the FROZEN block above was written at 2026-10-21T05:08:48.8Z (file mtime), before P1 started at 05:08:49Z per rg19/run.log. The "05:09Z" in its heading was rounded up. This note sets this file's mtime; the order is shown by the two timestamps above.

STOPPED 2026-10-21T05:33:04Z after 2 valid paced runs (P1 base, P2 cand). Run P3 was killed mid-run and is not used. Smoke was not run.
VERDICT: LOSS, determined by R2. Valid cand run 2 had 27 contended fence waits of 2 s or more held by
recovery/message_reconcile/database.rs, and R2 requires 0 in every valid cand run.
- R1 on the runs so far: base 2,452/2,633 and cand 2,489/2,633 reservation errors, where cand must be <= 25% of base.
- Reconciler: base scanned 4,926 and deferred 4,522; cand scanned 4,713 and deferred 4,470.
Mechanism refuted: the grace only delays WHEN each new message is verified. The tail lane still verifies every new message once
under the global fence (git open + committed-tree checks in reconcile_message_bundle_inner), so the fence load does not change.
